Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_ConnectRange_t: How far from a building's outline, in tiles, a device outside, a generator, water storage or a unit (solar panel, battery rack, pump, sprinkler, filter, booster pump) can be connected to a tier 1 utility panel. Higher tiers reach further (Range gain per tier), at most 32 tiles.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_SubPanelRange_: How far apart, in tiles, two buildings can be for one's utility panel to take supply from the other's, before the supplying panel's tier adds to it (Range gain per tier). A panel gives supply from tier 2.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_CostsEnabled_t: Connecting a generator, water storage, a unit, an outside device or a sub-panel takes tools and wire or pipe by length, and an upgrade takes its parts. On by default. Off: no tools or materials, but the Electricity levels are still needed.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_TilesPerPiece_: How many tiles of line one wire or one pipe makes.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_TilesPerFloor_: How many tiles of line each floor up or down adds to a line's length (wire or pipe and loss): a solar panel on the roof, a sub-panel on another floor. The ranges are measured on the ground. 0: floors add nothing.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_RefundPercent_: The percent of a line's wire and pipe given back when it is taken away.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_OverloadEnable: A utility panel whose load is over its limit (its tier's load plus its battery racks' output) heats its breaker, the faster the more it is over, until it trips and a player pushes the lever back up; at tier 4 it first turns off devices that are not essential. On by default. Off: no breaker trips and nothing is turned off for overload.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_Capacity1_tool: The load a tier 1 utility panel carries itself; its battery racks' output adds to it. A fridge and freezer draw 0.13, a stove 0.09, a washer 0.09, a light 0.002.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_Capacity2_tool: The load a tier 2 utility panel carries itself.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_Capacity3_tool: The load a tier 3 utility panel carries itself.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_LowFuelHours_t: Players near a utility panel are told when its generators have fuel for fewer hours than this. 0: no warning.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_ExperienceMult: Multiplies the Electricity experience for installing utility panels, laying wire and upgrading panels. 0 gives none.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_RangePerTier_t: Each utility panel tier above the first adds this share of the ranges above (50: tier 2 reaches 1.5 times, tier 3 twice, tier 4 2.5 times as far). Outside devices stay within 32 tiles.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_FloorReach_too: How many floors above and below its own a tier 1 utility panel's zone can take; higher tiers reach more (Range gain per tier). A taller building takes more panels: sub-panels on its other floors. 0: no limit.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_LossPerWire_to: The power line into a tier 1 utility panel, from its generator or its main panel, adds this much of the load per wire it took (the generator burns it and it counts toward overload). Tier 2 loses two thirds of that, tier 3 one third, tier 4 nothing. 0 turns losses off.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_Capacity4_tool: The load a tier 4 utility panel carries itself.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_SolarOutput_to: What one clean panel makes at a clear noon, as load (a fridge draws 0.13). Less in weaker daylight, none at night.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_SnowOnPanels_t: Snow settles on panels outside while it snows, covering them in two hours, and melts above 2 degrees C. Right-click "Brush Off Snow" clears it at once. On by default.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_SolarPanelLoot: How often finished solar panels turn up in crates, cardboard boxes and metal shelves: most in the storerooms of tool, electronics and outdoor supply stores, less in those stores, in farm storage and in warehouses. 1 (the default): a rare find. 2: twice as often. 0: none. The game's loot rarity for Other applies on top. Containers that already have their loot keep it. Needs Solar panels.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_BatteryCapacit: What a full standard car battery holds, in load-hours (a fridge takes 3.1 a day). Heavy-duty ones hold 1.5 times as much, sports ones 0.75. Worn ones hold less, 30 percent at condition 0.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_BatteryOutput_: The load a standard car battery adds to its panel's limit. Heavy-duty ones the same, sports ones 1.5 times. Worn ones add less, 30 percent at condition 0, and cold takes its share. Only while the bank has charge to give.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_ChargeEfficien: The share of the power going into batteries that they keep.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_WearRate_toolt: How fast batteries wear as they are used. Drawing a whole bank above half charge takes 1 condition, down to empty up to 6. 0: no wear.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_BatteryColdLoc: Below 0 degrees C at its racks (outside, while none is loaded) part of a bank's charge cannot be drawn: 1.5 percent a degree, at most 30 percent. It comes back as it warms. On by default.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_WornBatteryDra: Each battery below condition 30 takes 2 percent of its bank a day. On by default.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_WaterFromAbove: As vanilla plumbing: a fixture takes water only from water storage on the floors above it. Off (the default): also from water storage on its own floor. Either way never from water storage below (a booster pump lifts it up).
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_RiskPipesFreez: A utility panel's water stops after 6 hours below -5 degrees C at the panel (a heated building stays warmer) and flows again after 2 hours above 0. Off by default.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_RiskPlumbingUn: A utility panel's pipes give water as its water storage holds it: rain and river water comes out tainted unless a water filter of its group purifies it. Off by default (the game's pipes purify). Needs a PZ Extension API version that can keep the taint; otherwise it has no effect.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnablePower_to: Utility panels power their buildings from the generators, solar panels and battery racks connected to them, with breakers, line loss, timers and the rest of their power side. On by default. Off: panels give no power and nothing of their power side can be made or connected; generators and devices work as in the game without this mod. What was connected stays, and works again once this is on.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnableWater_to: Utility panels water their buildings from the water storage connected to them, with water groups, pumps, sprinklers, filters and booster pumps. On by default. Off: panels give no water and nothing of their water side can be made or connected; rain collectors and fixtures work as in the game without this mod. What was connected stays, and works again once this is on.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnableSolar_to: Solar panels can be made and put down, and power their panel by day. Needs Power. On by default. Off: none can be made; those put down make nothing and can still be removed.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnableBatterie: Battery racks can be made and put down, and from tier 2 store power in car batteries; worn car batteries can be reconditioned. Needs Power. On by default. Off: none can be made; those put down keep their batteries but take and give no power, and can still be emptied and removed.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnableChargeCo: From tier 3 a panel's charge controller hands the load to a generator when the batteries run low, charges them from it and starts no generator in quiet hours; at tier 4 it keeps devices that are not essential off to save the batteries. Needs Battery racks. On by default. Off: the batteries work as at tier 2.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnablePumps_to: Water pumps can be made and put down, and fill their panel's water storage from a river, a lake or a well while it has power. Needs Water and Power. On by default. Off: none can be made; those put down stand still, draw no power and can still be removed.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnableSprinkle: Sprinklers can be made and put down, and water the crops around them from their panel's water storage. Needs Water. On by default. Off: none can be made; those put down water nothing and can still be removed.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnableFilters_: Water filters can be made and put down, and purify their group's water while "Risk: pipes do not purify" is on. Needs Water. On by default. Off: none can be made; those put down purify nothing (with that risk on, the water comes out as the water storage holds it) and can still be removed.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_EnableBoosters: Booster pumps can be made and put down, and lift their panel's water up from their floor while it has power, so that floors above the water storage get water. Needs Water and Power. On by default. Off: none can be made; those put down stand still, draw no power and can still be removed.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_BoosterLift_to: How many floors above its own a booster pump lifts water to. Fixtures on those floors use the water storage at the booster's height and above. A booster on a floor another lifts to lifts on from there.
